lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least five distinct horizontal rows spanning the lateral flank from the gill slits to the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
